evidence.title: DataVolt's 2025 Milestones in Saudi Arabia and Uzbekistan
evidence.attribution: DataVolt via an unauthenticated public LinkedIn representation
evidence.excerpt: DataVolt reports first-phase starts for 4 MW Yanbu and 16 MW liquid-cooled Riyadh facilities, and says it broke ground on a new 12 MW Tashkent data center and made significant construction progress.

metadata.capacity_guardrail: The 12 MW, 16 MW, and 4 MW statements are untyped. None is assumed to be critical IT, gross facility, grid connection, generation, current load, or annual energy, and none is normalized.
metadata.riyadh_identity_guardrail: The post gives only Riyadh, 16 MW, liquid cooling, and first-phase wording. The descriptive record is not merged with an East Riyadh or MODON site, RYD SA1/SA2, or any other portfolio code without direct official linkage.
metadata.yanbu_identity_guardrail: The post gives only Yanbu, 4 MW, and first-phase wording. The descriptive record is not merged with YANBU SA4 or any other portfolio code without direct official linkage.
metadata.descriptive_name_guardrail: The Riyadh and Yanbu record names are transparent analyst descriptions built only from the reported city, untyped size, cooling wording where present, and first-phase wording; they are not represented as official facility names.
metadata.physical_status_scope: The three statements support project-level under_construction for the explicitly commenced or broken-ground first/current builds as of publication, but no finer stage, energization, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.capture_guardrail: No login, credentials, cookies, private account, or browser session were used. Raw publisher and platform bytes are not redistributed in the immutable artifact; the complete temporary capture directory was moved intact to Trash.
